incidents.title: LastPass employee targeted with deepfake CEO voice call
incidents.outcome: Blocked; employee ignored WhatsApp calls and messages and reported them.
incidents.confidenceReason: LastPass published the incident and called it an audio deepfake.
incidents.summary: An employee received WhatsApp calls, texts and a voicemail using an audio deepfake of the CEO, with urgency pressure. The employee recognised the signs and reported it; no impact.
incidents.quote: Attempted Audio Deepfake Call Targets LastPass Employee

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness

incidents.title: TA547 delivers Rhadamanthys stealer with likely LLM-written PowerShell
incidents.targets: German organizations, invoice lure impersonating retailer Metro
incidents.outcome: Campaign delivered Rhadamanthys information stealer via a PowerShell loader.
incidents.confidenceReason: Proofpoint researchers inferred LLM authorship from the script's style; no model is named.
incidents.summary: Proofpoint observed TA547 using a PowerShell script that its researchers suspect was generated by an LLM. The script ran in a chain that ended with the Rhadamanthys stealer. This is one of the earliest vendor-reported cases of an LLM-written loader from a tracked criminal actor.
incidents.quote: the actor appeared to use a PowerShell script that researchers suspect was generated by large language model (LLM) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, CoPilot, etc.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Proofpoint has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness

sources.title: Security Brief: TA547 Targets German Organizations with Rhadamanthys Stealer
